summary: Hardeman County, TN: 90 ft Aermotor tower on an active TN Division of Forestry work center; NHLR-registered 2022. No build date; location and elevation differ between sources.

facts.design: 90 ft Aermotor tower (NHLR); model not named

access.note: Register places the tower on an active TN Division of Forestry work center (2022); no public access described

events.note: Listed among extant Tennessee fire towers in the table dated March 26, 2014

evidence.supports: tower is on an active TDF work center and is a 90 ft Aermotor tower
evidence.quote: This tower is located on an active TN Division of Forestry work center. It contains a 90ft Aermotor Tower.

evidence.supports: state list row: Hornsby, Hardeman, 581 ft, 8-24 standing
the state list's notes say its table numbers (8-24 here) are district-tower numbers from a 1976 list of towers
table is titled as extant towers as of March 26, 2014
evidence.quote: Extant Tennessee Fire Towers as of March 26, 2014

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register coordinates 35.282954, -88.866625 vs state waypoint 35.2267, -88.8664, about six km apart by our calculation. Left unresolved; the story reports both.
Register gives 558 ft; state waypoint gives 581 ft. Left unresolved.

sources.title: Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers, 1933 to 1975
sources.publisher: National Park Service, National Register of Historic Places

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing or fire history found. Wikipedia's Hornsby page has no tower mention. Location conflict is open: the Register point is about six km north of the state waypoint; a site check or the Register's map would settle it. The record's coordinates (35.2267, -88.8664) are the state waypoint's. A Chamber of Commerce listing puts the TDF Hornsby office on Tower Lane; not used as a source.
